title: MV/MZ Need some more emotions for my character faces

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I'm just about at the point where I can go through all my game's dialogue and use the proper emotion face for each line. I'm using some of
these emotions from Palxan
as well as some faces from
this official pack
.
However, there are a lot of things that those don't cover, and some of them are things I need quite frequently. Right now, what I'd like to get most is "surprised" and "thinking" faces for the following characters:
Actor2_4
Actor3_6
Actor3_8
People4_4 (thinking only – she's a less important character in my game, so we don't see her get surprised)
Evil_1 (surprised only – this guy isn't much of a thinker)
I'm not sure how clear it is when I say "thinking" face, so I'll try to give some examples of the sorts of lines it would accompany. It's a face someone might have when saying things like "Hmm, perhaps we could try that" or "If I recall correctly…" or "I wonder if this will work" or "Actually, it's like this" or "I think that wouldn't work". If that seems too broad, skew more to the "Hmm" side of things.
For "surprised", it should be startled, shocked, or similar. They are surprised by what they just saw or experienced. In particular, this isn't used for a case where tries something crazy and another person reacts.
I'm slowly working through it and will likely have more emotion requests later, but for now, these are the top priority.
To avoid any confusion about how characters are identified, I copy-pasted the exact ones I need into a sheet in the same order they were mentioned above:
Note: I tagged this MZ because I've used both MV and MZ characters in my game, so I might mention some MZ characters later, but the specific ones mentioned in this post are all MV characters.
